SessionStart.command: sh -c 'if [ -f hooks/session-start.py ]; then exec python3 hooks/session-start.py; else exec python3 .agents/hooks/session-start.py; fi'

PreInvocation.command: sh -c 'if [ -f hooks/inject-workflow-state.py ]; then exec python3 hooks/inject-workflow-state.py; else exec python3 .agents/hooks/inject-workflow-state.py; fi'

hooks.command: sh -c 'if [ -f hooks/pre-tool-priority.py ]; then exec python3 hooks/pre-tool-priority.py; else exec python3 .agents/hooks/pre-tool-priority.py; fi'

Stop.command: sh -c 'if [ -f hooks/session-end.py ]; then exec python3 hooks/session-end.py; else exec python3 .agents/hooks/session-end.py; fi'
